Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the sync earlier. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off the vendor onboarding so we can issue POs and enable payments for your account. To get you fully activated our vendor intake needs three items:

- Completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities)
- Vendor intake questionnaire (banking details + remittance contacts)
- A signed vendor or PO acceptance (PDF or simple email is fine)

Can you confirm which tax form Novus will provide and whether we should expect a consolidated PDF or separate files? If you prefer, you can upload to the Drive link below or reply with attachments.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will validate the tax form and Ben will create the vendor record in our AP system; I will follow up with procurement if we need any additional documents. If everything is in order we aim to issue a test PO within 3 business days.
